scope: The standing red-brick castle, comprising the three connected wings, open west-facing courtyard, 33.5-metre observation tower, and all five lesser round turrets.

originalReview.notes: Exact published courtyard panorama. The original photographer kept the explicit own-work public-domain release in their later file revision. Used for the connected range elevations, window divisions and projecting courtyard entrance.

Exact published southern exterior. The original photographer kept the explicit own-work public-domain release in their later file revision. Used for the great tower crown, brick belt courses and minor turret proportions.

quallaSearch.notes: Only the two public-domain castle photographs are used. They match the exact Qualla originals and the photographer's file revisions with the public-domain releases.
